findings.description: The default CA bundle path is now used directly instead of being passed through extract_zipped_paths, so a certifi bundle that lives inside a zip archive is no longer extracted to a real file.
findings.rationale: Trigger: requests and certifi are installed as a zip archive or zipped egg, and verify is left at its default so cert_loc falls back to DEFAULT_CA_BUNDLE_PATH. Mechanism: the path points inside the archive, so os.path.exists(cert_loc) at line 303 returns False and the code raises OSError. Impact: every HTTPS request from such an installation fails, where the previous code extracted the bundle and succeeded. The title calls the call unused, but on this branch it is used.
